instruction: Single Storey Office Suite IFC And Revit Room Schedule CSV This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. In Revit, create a single-storey office suite, export the model as result.ifc, and export a Revit room schedule as result.csv in the Desktop. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc and result.csv; result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and result.csv is at least 20 bytes. 2. Result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 8 IfcSpace entities, 11 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, 1 IfcRoof, 7 IfcDoor entities, and 6 IfcWindow entities. 5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. 6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token reception at least once, open office at least once, meeting at least 3 times, pantry at least once, toilet at least once, and print at least once. 7. Result.csv is a Revit room schedule export with exactly the headers room name,area in that order and exactly 8 non-empty data rows. 8. Result.csv contains these exact room name and area rows: Reception=23.76, Meeting Room 1=34.56, Meeting Room 2=29.16, Meeting Room 3=18.36, Open Office=113.96, Pantry=8.16, Accessible Toilet=8.16, Print Room=8.16. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
